---
title: "Cleaning ARF and CALF: RT control and participant exclusions"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script:

1. Splits the trials into the RT control block and the four arithmetic tasks (ARF FR, ARF FC, CALF FR, CALF FC), and saves them uncleaned.
2. Records the device each student used.
3. Removes outlier trials from the RT control block, then flags students with too few RT control trials or low RT control accuracy.
4. Removes students who did not pass the RT control from the matching arithmetic tasks.
5. Removes students who responded very fast (and, for FC, near chance), and plots these cutoffs (Figure S4).
6. Removes K-1 students from CALF (CALF is not analysed for K-1).
7. Saves the cleaned files used by `get_scores_df.Rmd`.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggExtra)   # ggMarginal, for the marginal histograms in Figure S4
library(gridExtra) # arrangeGrob, to lay out Figure S4
library(grid)      # textGrob, rectGrob, for the Figure S4 labels
```

# Paths

```{r}
savepath <- paste0(here("data"), "/")
dir.create(paste0(savepath, "cleaning_arf_calf"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

results_dir <- here("results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load the cleaned trial data

```{r}
arf_data<-read.csv(paste0(savepath,"data_cleaning_1/arf-trials-clean.csv")) %>%
  filter(assessment_stage == "test_response")
calf_data<-read.csv(paste0(savepath,"data_cleaning_1/calf-trials-clean.csv")) %>%
  filter(assessment_stage == "test_response")
```

# Split and save the uncleaned task data

```{r}
# The RT control block is run within ARF, so it comes from the ARF trials
rt_block<-arf_data %>%
  filter(grepl("rtControl",meta_data.corpus_name))

arf_production <- arf_data %>%
  filter(str_starts(meta_data.corpus_name,"production_"))

arf_2afc <- arf_data %>%
  filter(str_starts(meta_data.corpus_name,"2afc_"))

calf_production <- calf_data %>%
  filter(str_starts(meta_data.corpus_name,"production_"))

calf_6afc <- calf_data %>%
  filter(str_starts(meta_data.corpus_name,"6afc_"))

write.csv(rt_block,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/rt-block.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/arf-production.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_2afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/arf-2afc.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/calf-production.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_6afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/calf-6afc.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

# Save the device each student used

```{r}
arf_pids<-arf_production %>%
  distinct(ID,trial_type) %>%
  mutate(device = ifelse(trial_type == "html-keyboard-response", "mobile", "desktop")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID,device)

calf_pids<-calf_production %>%
  distinct(ID,trial_type) %>%
  mutate(device = ifelse(trial_type == "html-keyboard-response", "mobile", "desktop")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID,device)

rt_block_pids<-rt_block %>%
  distinct(ID,meta_data.corpus_name,trial_type) %>%
  filter(meta_data.corpus_name == "rtControl_production") %>%
  mutate(device = ifelse(trial_type == "html-keyboard-response", "mobile", "desktop")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID,device)

all_pids<-rbind(arf_pids,calf_pids,rt_block_pids) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(ID)

write.csv(all_pids,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/device-prod.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

# RT control

## Remove outlier trials

```{r}
rt_block_out<-rt_block %>%
  group_by(ID, meta_data.corpus_name) %>%
  mutate(median_absolute_deviation=mad(rt),
         median_rt=median(rt)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rt_filter_criteria=case_when(meta_data.corpus_name=="rtControl_2afc" ~ 5*median_absolute_deviation,
                                      meta_data.corpus_name=="rtControl_6afc" ~ 5*median_absolute_deviation,
                                      meta_data.corpus_name=="rtControl_production" ~ 5*median_absolute_deviation),
         rt_distance_median = rt-median_rt)%>%
  filter(rt_distance_median<=rt_filter_criteria) %>%
  dplyr::select(-median_rt)

write.csv(rt_block_out,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/rt-block_outliers.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

## Remove students with not enough trials or low accuracy

```{r}
pid_remove_rt<-rt_block_out %>%
  group_by(ID,meta_data.corpus_name,user_grade_at_run) %>%
  summarise(proportion_correct=mean(correct),
            n_trials = n()) %>%
  filter((meta_data.corpus_name == "rtControl_production" & (n_trials<3 | proportion_correct<0.75)) |
         (meta_data.corpus_name == "rtControl_2afc" & (n_trials<5 | proportion_correct<0.875)) |
           (meta_data.corpus_name == "rtControl_6afc" & (n_trials<5 | proportion_correct<0.7917))) %>%
  ungroup()

pid_remove_prod<-pid_remove_rt %>%
  filter(meta_data.corpus_name == "rtControl_production") %>%
  dplyr::select(ID) %>%
  pull()

pid_remove_2afc<-pid_remove_rt %>%
  filter(meta_data.corpus_name == "rtControl_2afc") %>%
  dplyr::select(ID) %>%
  pull()

pid_remove_6afc<-pid_remove_rt %>%
  filter(meta_data.corpus_name == "rtControl_6afc") %>%
  dplyr::select(ID) %>%
  pull()
```

```{r}
# Save the cleaned RT control data
rt_block_clean<-rt_block_out %>%
  anti_join(pid_remove_rt, by = c("ID", "meta_data.corpus_name", "user_grade_at_run"))

write.csv(rt_block_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/rt-block_3-75_5-875-7917.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

# Arithmetic tasks

## Remove students who did not pass the matching RT control

```{r}
arf_production<-arf_production %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_prod))

arf_2afc<-arf_2afc %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_2afc))

calf_production<-calf_production %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_prod))

calf_6afc<-calf_6afc %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_6afc))

write.csv(arf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/arf-production-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_2afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/arf-2afc-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/calf-production-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_6afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/calf-6afc-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

## Get the median RT and accuracy

```{r}
score_metrics<-function(data, computed_correct, computed_attempted){
  data %>%
    mutate(proportion_correct={{computed_correct}}/{{computed_attempted}},
           log_rt=log(rt)) %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    mutate(median_rt=median(rt),
           median_log_rt=median(log_rt)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

arf_prod_out<-score_metrics(arf_production, scores.computed.FR.numCorrect, scores.computed.FR.numAttempted)
arf_2afc_out<-score_metrics(arf_2afc, scores.computed.FC.numCorrect, scores.computed.FC.numAttempted)
calf_prod_out<-score_metrics(calf_production, scores.computed.FR.numCorrect, scores.computed.FR.numAttempted)
calf_6afc_out<-score_metrics(calf_6afc, scores.computed.FC.numCorrect, scores.computed.FC.numAttempted)
```

## Figure S4: Participant Exclusion

```{r}
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 14) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black"),
      axis.line          = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "black"),
      legend.key.width   = unit(1.6, "lines"),
      plot.caption       = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = rel(0.7), hjust = 0),
      plot.caption.position = "plot"
    )
}

grade_levels   <- c("Kindergarten", as.character(1:12))
grade_labels_k <- c("K", as.character(1:12))
grade_cols <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(c("dodgerblue1", "firebrick1", "goldenrod1"))(13),
  grade_labels_k
)

prep <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, median_rt, proportion_correct, user_grade_at_run) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(grade = factor(user_grade_at_run, levels = grade_levels,
                          labels = grade_labels_k))
}

make_panel <- function(df, rt_cut, acc_cut = NULL) {
  p <- prep(df) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = proportion_correct, y = median_rt)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = grade), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = rt_cut, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    { if (!is.null(acc_cut)) geom_vline(xintercept = acc_cut, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) } +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grade_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(legend.position    = "none",
          axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "grey95", linewidth = 0.25))
  ggMarginal(p, type = "histogram", fill = "grey30", colour = "black")
}

strip <- function(lab, rot = 0, gap = unit(10, "pt")) {
  grobTree(
    rectGrob(width  = unit(1, "npc") - gap,
             height = unit(1, "npc") - gap,
             gp = gpar(fill = "grey85", col = NA)),
    textGrob(lab, rot = rot,
             gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Arial"))
  )
}

combined_plot <- arrangeGrob(
  grobs = list(
    nullGrob(),          strip("FR"),                                strip("FC"),
    strip("ARF",  rot = 90), make_panel(arf_prod_out,  rt_cut = 1000), make_panel(arf_2afc_out,  rt_cut = 1000, acc_cut = 0.6),
    strip("CALF", rot = 90), make_panel(calf_prod_out, rt_cut = 3000), make_panel(calf_6afc_out, rt_cut = 3000, acc_cut = 0.25)
  ),
  layout_matrix = matrix(1:9, nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  widths  = unit.c(unit(2, "lines"), unit(1, "null"), unit(1, "null")),
  heights = unit.c(unit(2, "lines"), unit(1, "null"), unit(1, "null"))
)

legend_src <- prep(arf_prod_out) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = proportion_correct, y = median_rt)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = grade)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = grade_cols) +
  labs(colour = "Grade") +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1,
                               override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

get_only_legend <- function(plot) {
  plot_table <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(plot))
  legend_plot <- which(sapply(plot_table$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  plot_table$grobs[[legend_plot]]
}
legend <- get_only_legend(legend_src)

yleft  <- textGrob("Median response time (ms)", rot = 90,
                   gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontfamily = "Arial"))
bottom <- textGrob("Proportion correct",
                   gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontfamily = "Arial"))

panels <- arrangeGrob(combined_plot, left = yleft, bottom = bottom)
final  <- arrangeGrob(panels, legend, nrow = 1,
                      widths = unit.c(unit(1, "null"), sum(legend$widths)))

grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(final)

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "sup4_figure1_participant_exclusion_combined.png"),
       plot = final, width = 10.5, height = 7.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Remove very fast and inaccurate students

```{r}
arf_prod_clean<-arf_prod_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=1000)

arf_2afc_clean<-arf_2afc_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=1000 | proportion_correct>0.6)

calf_prod_clean<-calf_prod_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=3000) %>%
 filter(user_grade_at_run != "1" & user_grade_at_run != "Kindergarten")

calf_6afc_clean<-calf_6afc_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=3000 | proportion_correct>0.25) %>%
 filter(user_grade_at_run != "1" & user_grade_at_run != "Kindergarten")
```

```{r}
write.csv(arf_prod_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/arf-production-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_2afc_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/arf-2afc-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_prod_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/calf-production-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_6afc_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_arf_calf/calf-6afc-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```
